verdict.rationale: Finix documents managing seller payouts through the Dashboard or API, and setting payout schedules, so platforms can control when sellers get paid. Nothing in the pack describes holding seller funds in a balance until delivery or dispute windows pass, releasing on an event trigger, or the limits of any escrow-like mechanism. Settlement-timing and dispute features are mentioned, but not as a hold-and-release flow. missing for 10: explicit fund-hold/escrow balance capability, trigger- or API-driven release of held funds, tying holds to dispute or delivery windows, documented limits on hold duration and amount, independent corroboration.
